# Gcore Managed DNS

> Configure Gcore Managed DNS with Anycast routing, DNSSEC, Healthchecks, dynamic response, and integrations.

- [Overview](https://docs.gcore.com/dns.md): Configure Gcore Managed DNS with Anycast routing, DNSSEC, Healthchecks, dynamic response, and integrations.
- [Gcore Managed DNS glossary](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/gcore-dns-glossary.md): View Gcore Managed DNS terminology definitions - A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV records, DNS zones, propagation, DNSSEC, and authoritative name servers.
- [Getting started with Managed DNS](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/manage-a-dns-zone.md): Create a DNS zone in Gcore Managed DNS via Customer Portal or REST API, point nameservers to Gcore, and verify public delegation.
- [Migrate DNS from Cloudflare to Gcore](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/migrate-from-cloudflare.md): Migrate DNS records from Cloudflare to Gcore Managed DNS - export a zone file, import records, and switch nameservers at the registrar.

## Records
- [Supported DNS record types](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-records.md): Create A, AAAA, NS, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV, CAA, HTTPS, SVCB, and PTR records in Gcore Managed DNS with TTL, class, and IPv4 and IPv6 address values.
- [Manage DNS records](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-records/manage-dns-records-non-advanced-interface-mode.md): Create and manage A, AAAA, NS, CNAME, MX, SRV, HTTPS, TXT, CAA, and SVCB DNS records in Gcore Managed DNS zones via Customer Portal or REST API.
- [Manage DNS records (advanced interface mode with dynamic response)](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-records/manage-dns-records-advanced-interface-mode-with-balancing.md): Create and manage DNS RRsets with dynamic response (pickers) via Customer Portal or REST API, in advanced interface mode, supporting A, AAAA, NS, CNAME, MX, SRV, HTTPS, TXT, CAA, and SVCB types.
- [Import and export records](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-records/import-and-export-records.md): Export DNS records to a BIND zone file or import records from a BIND zone file into an existing Gcore Managed DNS zone via Customer Portal or REST API. Import adds new RRsets; existing RRsets with the same name and type are skipped.
- [Create records in zone apex (CNAME flattening)](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-records/specify-cname-at-root.md): Configure CNAME flattening at the zone apex in Gcore Managed DNS, remove conflicting records and create a CNAME record at the apex, via Customer Portal or REST API.
- [Configure DNS records to send emails](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-records/set-up-dns-for-sending-email.md): Configure A, MX, PTR, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records in Gcore Managed DNS to enable email delivery and prevent spam and spoofing.
- [Setting up a PTR record and reverse DNS zone](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-records/set-up-a-ptr-record-and-reverse-dns-zone.md): Add PTR records to reverse DNS zones to map IP addresses to hostnames for email anti-spam validation and subnet tracing using Gcore Managed DNS.
- [Configure HTTPS records](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-records/what-is-an-https-record-and-how-is-it-configured.md): Create HTTPS records in Gcore Managed DNS to deliver protocol versions and IP address hints in a single DNS query.

## Advanced managing
- [Dynamic response](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-records/configure-weight-balancing-and-geobalancing.md): Configure dynamic DNS responses in Gcore Managed DNS to route queries by weight, geolocation, country, ASN, or proximity via Customer Portal or REST API.
- [DNS Healthchecks](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-failover/configure-and-use-dns-failover.md): Configure DNS Healthchecks in Gcore Managed DNS to monitor server availability, exclude failing records from DNS responses, and set up backup records via Customer Portal or REST API.
- [Configure CDN integration](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-records/advanced-managing/cdn-integration.md): Configure A or AAAA DNS records in Gcore Managed DNS to route directly to Gcore CDN by linking a record to a CDN resource via the Customer Portal or REST API.
- [Getting started with DNSSEC](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/getting-started-with-dnssec.md): Enable and manage DNSSEC for Gcore DNS zones, monitor all lifecycle states including pending transitions, and verify DS propagation at the registrar via Customer Portal or REST API using Python SDK, Go SDK, or curl.

## Integrations
- [Configure OctoDNS with Gcore Managed DNS](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-plugins/use-gcore-dns-as-a-secondary-dns-with-octodns.md): Use OctoDNS to synchronize DNS records from a primary provider to Gcore Managed DNS - install packages, create a YAML configuration, and run sync commands.
- [Get a Let's Encrypt certificate with Certbot](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-plugins/get-a-let-s-encrypt-certificate-with-certbot.md): Configure Let's Encrypt certificate issuance for domains using Gcore Managed DNS with the Certbot DNS plugin via DNS-01 challenge and API token credentials.

## Terraform
- [Manage DNS zones and records via Terraform v0](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-plugins/manage-dns-with-terraform.md): Create and manage Gcore Managed DNS zones and records using Terraform gcore_dns_zone and gcore_dns_zone_record resources, supporting A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV, CAA record types, DNSSEC, SOA parameters, webhook notifications, and geo-balancing with continent and country blocks.
- [Manage DNS zones and records via Terraform v2](https://docs.gcore.com/dns/dns-plugins/manage-dns-with-terraform-v2.md): Create and manage Gcore Managed DNS zones and records using Terraform provider v2 gcore_dns_zone and gcore_dns_zone_rrset resources, supporting A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, SRV, CAA, PTR record types, DNSSEC, SOA parameters, and geo-balancing with pickers and JSON-encoded meta values.
